implementation: The old compute/inference profiles retain their existing contracts, default UID65534 and WSL flags0. The new workspace profile is opt-in, independently publisher-pinned, and can operate without any model pack

The actual commissioned original Windows Admin remains the product-custody role. A new unique local Linux account has UID/GID1000, no sudo/root membership and no shared/default password. Windows SID is not treated as Linux PAM proof

Original-client selection, nonce, release/runtime/profile, actor SID commitment, account generation and one unambiguous independently signed UTC day are durably prepared in the CNG/NV journal before suspended-controller start and resume

A distinct bounded invocation opens a new owned console only after explicit setup/repair review. No redirected standard handles, inherited pipe handles, caller-selected executable, secret argv, password verifier or secret review commitment is accepted

Actual local hidden TTY password entry, fixed distribution yescrypt and the separately held real PAM helper implement creation/authentication. Exact ordered four-file before/after account deltas, private staging, owned home identity and fsync witnesses support interruption inspection

Explicit fresh Admin repair can initialize a never-started original account only if the entire transaction stage is absent, every original baseline is untouched and no home/publication temporary exists. Existing partial, malformed or unrelated stages are retained/refused, never adopted

Password aging remains the original protected creation day with a ninety-day maximum. Repair does not reset or extend aging. A reconstructed high-water day refuses rollback behind any previously journaled account admission, including cancelled health admissions

One controller is allowed per resource purpose. A fresh health challenge uses a separate resource/nonce session after original-console exit and exact persistent request-revocation plus repeated inactive-unit/empty-cgroup/absent-job drain observations

Health joins release/runtime/profile, original bootstrap request, current actor/UTC/nonce and private account-state witness to genuine Windows journal history. A previously observed account closure cannot silently change. Historical once-PAM verification is not a renewed user grant

The model-disabled manual Windows console reuses existing independently authenticated scoped Read, whole-snapshot protected NTFS Save, diagnostics, explicit repair and cancel. It holds no lease while idle; each action obtains a fresh bounded ceremony. No Read receipt is Export authority and SYSTEM never receives an arbitrary output path

Windows and guest each observe 1.25GiB startup headroom and a 1GiB continuous floor around the 256MiB/swap0/eight-task/one-CPU/25CPU-second guest worker. These are sampled observations, not atomic reservations or guarantees against unrelated workloads

All review, UTC delivery, execution, drainage and result delivery remain inside the original thirty-second purpose. Unknown/suspended host protection or unsupported managed-policy authorization refuses new writes. Drain/recovery remains separately accessible
